goal: Pilot, preregistration, main evaluation, ablations, robustness, failure analysis, and technical report
acceptance: Every preregistered hypothesis reported with effect size, CI, and Holm-adjusted p; every ablation classified; failure codes cover all failed B0 and A2 test tasks; reports regenerate byte-for-byte from archived raw outputs
boundaries: Follow AGENTS.md; deterministic code enforces safety, budgets, and answer contracts
Never weaken, skip, or delete a test or gate to obtain PASS
No secrets in code, configs, traces, reports, or commits
Never claim performance results from dev/val runs, FakeLLM, or replay as experimental results
No config, prompt, or budget change after preregistration; post-hoc analyses are labeled exploratory
Stop at max_experiment_usd; never exceed the approved budget

model_policy.independent_reviewer: stronger independent model or human reviewer, read-only
